verdict.rationale: Viam's official CLI can call any machine API method with JSON in and JSON out and is described as a complete way to operate a machine from a shell. The docs also say an AI agent with a shell or an SDK can operate a machine, and the fleet API lets you manage machines in code the same way as the web UI. viam-server can also run locally against a fake config, which suits automated testing. Missing for 10: CI-specific guidance (e.g., pipeline examples), documented non-interactive or API-key authentication for unattended runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
